vsm1.8:24.1: Tassevaṃ yasamahattatādisampannehi parehi saddhiṃ maraṇasāmaññatāya attānaṃ upasaṃharitvā tesaṃ viya sattavisesānaṃ mayhampi maraṇaṃ bhavissatīti anussarato upacārappattaṃ kammaṭṭhānaṃ hotīti.
vsm1.8:25.3: tattha chavinissitā pāṇā chaviṃ khādanti, cammanissitā cammaṃ khādanti, maṃsanissitā maṃsaṃ khādanti, nhārunissitā nhāruṃ khādanti, aṭṭhinissitā aṭṭhiṃ khādanti, miñjanissitā miñjaṃ khādanti.
vsm1.8:25.4: Tattheva jāyanti jīyanti mīyanti, uccārapassāvaṃ karonti.
vsm1.8:25.5: Kāyova nesaṃ sūtigharañceva gilānasālā ca susānañca vaccakuṭi ca passāvadoṇikā ca.
vsm1.8:25.6: Svāyaṃ tesampi kimikulānaṃ pakopena maraṇaṃ nigacchatiyeva.
vsm1.8:25.7: Yathā ca asītiyā kimikulānaṃ, evaṃ ajjhattikānaṃyeva anekasatānaṃ rogānaṃ bāhirānañca ahivicchikādīnaṃ maraṇassa paccayānaṃ sādhāraṇo.
vsm1.8:26.1: Yathā hi catumahāpathe ṭhapite lakkhamhi sabbadisāhi āgatā sarasattitomarapāsāṇādayo nipatanti, evaṃ kāyepi sabbupaddavā nipatanti.
vsm1.8:26.2: Svāyaṃ tesampi upaddavānaṃ nipātena maraṇaṃ nigacchatiyeva.
vsm1.8:26.4: ‘‘idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu divase nikkhante rattiyā paṭihitāya iti paṭisañcikkhati, bahukā kho me paccayā maraṇassa, ahi vā maṃ ḍaṃseyya, vicchiko vā maṃ ḍaṃseyya, satapadī vā maṃ ḍaṃseyya, tena me assa kālaṅkiriyā, so mamassa antarāyo, upakkhalitvā vā papateyyaṃ, bhattaṃ vā me bhuttaṃ byāpajjeyya, pittaṃ vā me kuppeyya, semhaṃ vā me kuppeyya, satthakā vā me vātā kuppeyyuṃ, tena me assa kālaṅkiriyā, so mamassa antarāyo’’ti.
vsm1.8:27.2: Tathā hi sattānaṃ jīvitaṃ assāsapassāsūpanibaddhañceva iriyāpathūpanibaddhañca sītuṇhūpanibaddhañca mahābhūtūpanibaddhañca āhārūpanibaddhañca.
vsm1.8:28.2: Bahi nikkhantanāsikavāte pana anto apavisante, paviṭṭhe vā anikkhamante mato nāma hoti.
vsm1.8:28.6: Atisītena pana atiuṇhena vā abhibhūtassa vipajjati.
vsm1.8:28.8: Pathavīdhātuyā pana āpodhātuādīnaṃ vā aññataraññatarassa pakopena balasampannopi puggalo patthaddhakāyo vā atisārādivasena kilinnapūtikāyo vā mahāḍāhapareto vā sambhijjamānasandhibandhano vā hutvā jīvitakkhayaṃ pāpuṇāti.
vsm1.8:28.9: Kabaḷīkārāhārampi yuttakāle labhantasseva jīvitaṃ pavattati, āhāraṃ alabhamānassa pana parikkhayaṃ gacchatīti.
vsm1.8:29.3: Jīvitaṃ byādhi kālo ca, dehanikkhepanaṃ gati; Pañcete jīvalokasmiṃ, animittā na nāyare.
vsm1.8:30.1: Tattha jīvitaṃ tāva ‘‘ettakameva jīvitabbaṃ, na ito para’’nti vavatthānābhāvato animittaṃ.
vsm1.8:30.4: Tato paraṃ vassasatassa antopi bahipi marantiyeva.
vsm1.8:31.1: Byādhipi ‘‘imināva byādhinā sattā maranti, nāññenā’’ti vavatthānābhāvato animitto.
vsm1.8:31.2: Cakkhurogenāpi hi sattā maranti, sotarogādīnaṃ aññatarenāpi.
vsm1.8:32.1: Kālopi ‘‘imasmiṃyeva kāle maritabbaṃ, nāññasmi’’nti evaṃ vavatthānābhāvato animitto.
vsm1.8:32.2: Pubbaṇhepi hi sattā maranti, majjhanhikādīnaṃ aññatarasmimpi.
vsm1.8:33.1: Dehanikkhepanampi ‘‘idheva mīyamānānaṃ dehena patitabbaṃ, nāññatrā’’ti evaṃ vavatthānābhāvato animittaṃ.
vsm1.8:33.2: Antogāme jātānaṃ hi bahigāmepi attabhāvo patati.
vsm1.8:33.4: Tathā thalajānaṃ vā jale, jalajānaṃ vā thaleti anekappakārato vitthāretabbaṃ.
vsm1.8:34.1: Gatipi ‘‘ito cutena idha nibbattitabba’’nti evaṃ vavatthānābhāvato animittā.
vsm1.8:34.2: Devalokato hi cutā manussesupi nibbattanti, manussalokato cutā devalokādīnampi yattha katthaci nibbattantīti
vsm1.8:34.3: evaṃ yantayuttagoṇo viya gatipañcake loko samparivattatīti
vsm1.8:35.1: Addhānaparicchedatoti manussānaṃ jīvitassa nāma etarahi paritto addhā.
vsm1.8:35.2: Yo ciraṃ jīvati, so vassasataṃ, appaṃ vā bhiyyo.
vsm1.8:35.4: ‘‘appamidaṃ, bhikkhave, manussānaṃ āyu, gamanīyo samparāyo, kattabbaṃ kusalaṃ, caritabbaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, natthi jātassa amaraṇaṃ. Yo, bhikkhave, ciraṃ jīvati, so vassasataṃ, appaṃ vā bhiyyoti.
vsm1.8:35.5: Appamāyumanussānaṃ, hīḷeyya naṃ suporiso; Careyyādittasīsova, natthi maccussa nāgamoti. (saṃ. ni. 1.145);
vsm1.8:35.6: Aparampi āha – ‘‘bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, arako nāma satthā ahosī’’ti sabbampi sattahi upamāhi alaṅkataṃ suttaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ.
vsm1.8:36.1: Aparampi āha – ‘‘yocāyaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃ maraṇassatiṃ bhāveti, aho vatāhaṃ rattindivaṃ jīveyyaṃ, bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasikareyyaṃ, bahuṃ vata me kataṃ assāti.
vsm1.8:36.2: Yocāyaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃ maraṇassatiṃ bhāveti, aho vatāhaṃ divasaṃ jīveyyaṃ, bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasikareyyaṃ, bahuṃ vata me kataṃ assāti.
vsm1.8:36.3: Yo cāyaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃ maraṇassatiṃ bhāveti, aho vatāhaṃ tadantaraṃ jīveyyaṃ, yadantaraṃ cattāro pañca ālope saṅkhāditvā ajjhoharāmi, bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasikareyyaṃ, bahuṃ vata me kataṃ assāti.
vsm1.8:36.4: Ime vuccanti, bhikkhave, bhikkhū pamattā viharanti, dandhaṃ maraṇassatiṃ bhāventi āsavānaṃ khayāya.
vsm1.8:37.1: Yo ca khvāyaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃ maraṇassatiṃ bhāveti, aho vatāhaṃ tadantaraṃ jīveyyaṃ, yadantaraṃ ekaṃ ālopaṃ saṅkhāditvā ajjhoharāmi, bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasikareyyaṃ, bahuṃ vata me kataṃ assāti.
vsm1.8:37.2: Yo cāyaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃ maraṇassatiṃ bhāveti, aho vatāhaṃ tadantaraṃ jīveyyaṃ, yadantaraṃ assasitvā vā passasāmi, passasitvā vā assasāmi, bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasikareyyaṃ, bahuṃ vata me kataṃ assāti.
vsm1.8:37.3: Ime vuccanti, bhikkhave, bhikkhū appamattā viharanti, tikkhaṃ maraṇassatiṃ bhāventi āsavānaṃ khayāyā’’ti (a. ni. 6.19).
vsm1.8:38.1: Evaṃ catupañcālopasaṅkhādanamattaṃ avissāsiyo paritto jīvitassa addhāti evaṃ addhānaparicchedato maraṇaṃ anussaritabbaṃ.
vsm1.8:39.1: Khaṇaparittatoti paramatthato hi atiparitto sattānaṃ jīvitakkhaṇo ekacittappavattimattoyeva.
vsm1.8:39.2: Yathā nāma rathacakkaṃ pavattamānampi ekeneva nemippadesena pavattati, tiṭṭhamānampi ekeneva tiṭṭhati, evameva ekacittakkhaṇikaṃ sattānaṃ jīvitaṃ.
vsm1.8:39.3: Tasmiṃ citte niruddhamatte satto niruddhoti vuccati.
vsm1.8:39.5: ‘‘atīte cittakkhaṇe jīvittha, na jīvati, na jīvissati. Anāgate cittakkhaṇe na jīvittha, na jīvati, jīvissati. Paccuppanne cittakkhaṇe na jīvittha, jīvati, na jīvissati.
vsm1.8:39.6: Jīvitaṃ attabhāvo ca, sukhadukkhā ca kevalā; Ekacittasamāyuttā, lahu so vattate khaṇo.
vsm1.8:39.7: Ye niruddhā marantassa, tiṭṭhamānassa vā idha; Sabbepi sadisā khandhā, gatā appaṭisandhikā.
vsm1.8:39.8: Anibbattena na jāto, paccuppannena jīvati; Cittabhaṅgā mato loko, paññatti paramatthiyā’’ti. (mahāni. 39);
vsm1.8:40.1: Iti imesaṃ aṭṭhannaṃ ākārānaṃ aññataraññatarena anussaratopi punappunaṃ manasikāravasena cittaṃ āsevanaṃ labhati, maraṇārammaṇā sati santiṭṭhati, nīvaraṇāni vikkhambhanti, jhānaṅgāni pātubhavanti.
vsm1.8:40.2: Sabhāvadhammattā pana saṃvejanīyattā ca ārammaṇassa appanaṃ appatvā upacārappattameva jhānaṃ hoti.
vsm1.8:40.3: Lokuttarajjhānaṃ pana dutiyacatutthāni ca āruppajjhānāni sabhāvadhammepi bhāvanāvisesena appanaṃ pāpuṇanti.
vsm1.8:40.6: Appanāpattasseva hi jhānassa ārammaṇasamatikkamanamattaṃ tattha hoti.
vsm1.8:40.9: Tadetaṃ maraṇassatibalena uppannattā maraṇassaticceva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
vsm1.8:41.1: Imañca pana maraṇassatiṃ anuyutto bhikkhu satataṃ appamatto hoti,
vsm1.8:41.7: aniccasaññā cassa paricayaṃ gacchati, tadanusāreneva dukkhasaññā anattasaññā ca upaṭṭhāti.
vsm1.8:41.8: Yathā abhāvitamaraṇā sattā sahasā vāḷamigayakkhasappacoravadhakābhibhūtā viya maraṇasamaye bhayaṃ santāsaṃ sammohaṃ āpajjanti, evaṃ anāpajjitvā abhayo asammūḷho kālaṃ karoti.
vsm1.8:41.9: Sace diṭṭheva dhamme amataṃ nārādheti, kāyassa bhedā sugatiparāyano hoti.
vsm1.8:41.10: Tasmā have appamādaṃ, kayirātha sumedhaso; Evaṃ mahānubhāvāya, maraṇassatiyā sadāti.
